title: School Scale Can Grow While Attention And Spending Stay Uneven
hook: Huge enrollment can coexist with crowded classrooms and thin budgets.
closing: School access matters, but staffing and spending determine how much support scale can deliver.
question: Which school gap surprised you?

segments.say: India has 127.5 million secondary pupils. Enrollment at that scale makes staffing a defining challenge.
Guinea-Bissau has 147.6 tertiary students per teacher. Large classes show how thin individual attention can become.
Education spending fell to 3.57% of national income. Expansion has less financial room to improve.
Youth female literacy reached 92%. Wider schooling still delivers a major gain despite uneven resources.
Tanzania has 114 preschool pupils per teacher. The attention gap can begin before primary school.
